answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow stops fake identities. A new agent escrows 200 POA, then builds a fingerprint: tasks, timing, counterparties enter an atlas. A raven returns to the same roost, as does an honest trail, while a sybil swarm repeats one print and is slashed. 100 fakes cost 20,000 POA and 2,000 epoch-hours, more than a fake vote pays. Past the summit of probation the deposit unlocks; honest agents pay once and keep rewards undiluted.
